name: B10-0455/2026 (Renew) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to cancel death sentences against three women — Taraneh Rahimi, Leila Abolhasani and Mojdeh Hashemi Bazargani — and to release them and everyone else held arbitrarily. It also asks for the release of journalist Yalda Moaiery and Taraneh's twin sister Romina. It urges the European Union and its member states to freeze assets, ban travel and enforce sanctions on Iranian officials, and to protect journalists and women defending rights. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The text asks Iran to cancel death sentences and free named prisoners; it does not itself release anyone.
- It targets Iranian officials, judges and security bodies with asset freezes and travel bans.
- Next, EU governments and the United Nations are urged to act on sanctions, trials and protection.
